text_block_list.text:
—The New Year. Amidst the crisp cold that 
felt entirely refreshing, we headed to a 
shrine near the Academy.

Starting this year, Admire Vega finally 
joins the ranks of the Senior division.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think they'll praise me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"If I run a lot and win a lot... ...then 
maybe someday, I'll be able to see her."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes... please take care 
of me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Will you... praise me—?

...She had lost something immense, but in 
return, she had gained a tiny seed of 
hope. I want to do everything I can to 
support her again this year.

With those thoughts in mind, just as I was 
about to line up in the bustling queue for 
worship—
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Ayabe! So you came too...?
Ayabe! You were here too...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...

Admire Vega, who stood staring fixedly in 
that direction without making any move to 
join the line, notices me.

And with that, her gaze wandered 
hesitantly for a moment, as if feeling out 
of place—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Happy New Year.
choice_data_list:
L-Looking forward to working with you this 
year too, then?!

text_block_list.text:
She gave me the standard greeting for now. 
...She was quite dutiful.
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you going to visit the shrine?
...Aren't you going to visit the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't think of anything.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......Um. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Achoo!
choice_data_list: Whoa! Are you okay!?
Whoa! Are you okay!?

text_block_list.text:
For now, I decided to ask about the 
circumstances somewhere warm...

The cafe we somehow managed to squeeze 
into amidst the New Year crowds was quite 
noisy, filled with a somewhat restless 
atmosphere.

In a faint voice that seemed on the verge 
of being swallowed up by the clamor, she 
quietly let slip.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I realized that I needed to live my life 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because that's what she said at the very 
end... No, it's not just about making 
amends, either...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I just wanted to grant her wish.
choice_data_list: ...I see.
...I see.

text_block_list.text:
At the core of Admire Vega is her sister, 
after all. That hasn't changed ever since 
the day we met.

...Still, some things definitely have 
changed over these past two years.

Right now, she isn't trying to sacrifice 
herself for her younger sister's wish like 
she once did—
choice_data_list:
(She's trying to live on with her wish 
held close to her heart.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"So, um. ...In order to get my act 
together and live properly, I thought I 
should make a New Year's resolution first, 
just like everyone else..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Just... Something I want to swear, I 
guess...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I just couldn't think of 'what I want 
to do.'
choice_data_list: Is that so?
Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanted to erase 'myself'. As much as 
possible, until now."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"To dedicate it to my little sister, and 
for that alone, I wanted to exhaust as 
much of 'myself' as possible."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Because if I didn't, I felt like I 
would be dishonest with her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"That's why... I wanted to ignore my own 
desires as much as possible, anything 
unrelated to running, unrelated to what I 
had to fulfill."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Because doing that—looking away, ignoring 
it— is how I've always gotten by, so—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...At this point, asking myself 'what do I 
want to do'... ...I just don't know.
choice_data_list: I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

She seems to be overthinking things quite 
a bit. Or perhaps that, too, is just 
typical of her difficulty in properly 
looking at 'herself'.

To an outsider at least, it sounded like 
what she wanted to vow had been decided 
from the very beginning.
choice_data_list: 'I want to live properly'

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list:
Wouldn't that make a good New Year's 
resolution?

Wouldn't that make a great New Year's 
resolution?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose.

“—And with that, we made our way back to 
the shrine. Past noon, the flood of 
worshipers showed no signs of slowing, and 
the line was moving at a literal snail's 
pace.”

“However, perhaps it was just right. ……At 
least for her, as she awkwardly, clumsily 
stepped forward beside me.”
—And so, our turn had finally arrived.

Following her lead as she closes her eyes 
and puts her hands together, I make a 
wish. "May Admire Vega have a year where—"
choice_data_list: (Wishing you the very best of health!)

(I hope she gets to shine in lots of 
races.)
(May you find plenty of things to enjoy.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...See you, then. Let's meet back at 
training.
choice_data_list:
Eat something warm and get plenty of rest, 
okay!

Eat something warm and get plenty of rest, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? We don't have time for—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah... No.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Right. I'll do... my best to do that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...See you, then. Let's meet back at 
training.
choice_data_list:
Get even stronger and let's win big again 
this year!

Get even stronger and let's win a lot 
again this year, okay!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what I want to do. So—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...See you, then. Let's meet back at 
training.
choice_data_list: You better take plenty of breaks too!

Make sure you take plenty of breaks too, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Take a breather...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's... right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can think of something...
